title: We did a private tour...
text:
We did a private tour with Marina. She was very friendly and had great English. She gave us a good amount of information, which kept it interesting for the children.
The only thing that could be improved is being able to reach the brakes on the bike. 
It was a good distance so you don’t get tired and can enjoy the rest of the day after. Marina offered us two possible routes and we chose to go down by the coast which was very flat and very little on the road.
author: Megan_S

title: Fun and interesting.
text: It was really fun. Lillo was our guide and took us to many spots of interest. He sneaked through the traffic like a champ. It was really fun and interesting at the same time. I would recommend it.

title: Great bike tour
text: A really enjoyable few hours through the very bike friendly streets and parks of Barcelona. Felt very safe with Luba leading the way. She was friendly and informative, with lots of advice and recommendations about Barcelona.

title: Great way to see some of...
text: Great way to see some of the city landmarks while getting some exercise. Artem did a great job as group leader with 15 people to keep track of.
author: Edward_D

title: Great orientation to the city and its sites!
text: Great experience seeing Barcelona on bikes with our super friendly guide Luba. A great system of bike paths made the experience feel safe, but we were still glad to have a guide to figure out the traffic signals and the best routes. Luba knows a lot of history and really loves Barcelona which made it fun. After the tour, she recommended some great restaurants near our hotel and some other sites to visit. I would highly recommend this tour. There were just five of us, three on e-bikes and two on regular. The route is pretty flat, so you probably don’t need an e-bike if you’re pretty fit.
author: Safari52915834219

title: Bike tour
text: This tour was delayed by one day due to storms in Barcelona. We did complete the tour and had a good time. Our guide was Alex, he taught us lots of facts on our stops and was able to give fabulous recommendations for places to eat afterwards.
author: snoblit

title: GREAT INTRO TO BARCELONA🚲
text: Lub was our guide, cheeky and fun and very safety conscious. Helmets are optional, we took normal bikes and there was no challenge climbing so avoiding   €20 extra for e-bikes we were happy w our choice. There’s quite a bit of mucking around before you start your tour so get there early to help the guide leave on time.
